criteria.requirement: Add HookCaller.set_history_limit(None|nonnegative int) and clear_history(predicate=None)->removed count, only for historic hooks. Default unlimited remains unchanged. Retain newest N events for future replay, limit zero still delivers live calls but stores none; predicate receives a shallow kwargs copy and must be side-effect free. Selector errors before commit leave history unchanged. Historic replay iterates a stable start snapshot so clear/append during replay affect future replays without skipping or infinite growth in the current replay. Subset callers share the original history policy. Preserve previously accepted call-time shallow snapshots and result callbacks; clearing never retracts external effects.
